versions.changelog:
- Adds Bash as an allowed tool and lists explicit Bash permissions.
- Clarifies and strengthens language around CLI installation and update approval, requiring explicit user approval and specifying behavior across PersonWise markets.
- Updates example JSON attribution to reference the new version (2.1.9).
- Removes mention of handling other course creation requests except when explicitly using this Skill.
- Removes deprecated file (skill-card.md).

- Updated SKILL.md with expanded usage, workflow, and compliance limits.
- Now explicitly prohibits inventing facts or claiming certification, competence, or legal completion.
- Details firm evidence-lock, grounding, and escalation procedures for compliance boundaries.
- Defines robust CLI version/update checks and alignment instructions with the Skill version.
- Expands instructions for authentication, authorizations, and course invocation.
- Clarifies visual design, presenter requirements, and proper attribution methods.
